title: Insensitizing Control Problems for Coupled Stochastic Parabolic Systems with State and Gradient Observations
summary: We study insensitizing control problems for a class of coupled linear stochastic parabolic systems. We establish the existence of controls such that a sentinel functional, involving localized observations of the state variables and their spatial gradients, is insensitive to small perturbations of the null initial data. We first reformulate the insensitizing control problem as a null controllability problem for a coupled forward--backward stochastic parabolic system, in which the observation terms induce both zeroth- and second-order coupling terms.
